production_changes: Expose chronological replay block count and require uniform block wins before an admitted observation counterfactual displaces a supported primary.
Preserve but withhold a host-sampled model prior with no historical skill evidence from recommendation selection when the immutable primary is supported or context-trusted.
Make best-effort fallback and selector eligibility respect the same top-level human recommendation boundary.
residual_risks: The proper-score confirmation is a small six-task shard and does not estimate universal CiK performance.
Some useful sampled priors remain outcome-scoring-only when a primary is fully supported; later same-series outcome graduation can supply stronger authority.
Prior-assisted and hypothetical recommendations remain human-review-only and cannot authorize automation.
